name: Weather
summary: Current conditions for any place with /weather Berlin, from Open-Meteo.
description: /weather place looks a place up and answers with its current temperature, what it feels like, the sky and the wind, for example Berlin, Germany: overcast, 12.3C (feels like 10.1C), wind 14 km/h. It needs no account or key. It asks Open-Meteo, a free weather service, so it needs the net.fetch capability, limited to geocoding-api.open-meteo.com and api.open-meteo.com. Nothing else is reachable, and nothing about the person who asked is sent: only the place name they typed.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Check the weather
permissions.description: Look up the weather for a place with /weather.
